Title: Public Thesis Defense Presentations, Graduate School, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year: How Master's/Doctoral Seminar Students Can Attend
Posted: 2026-11-06

This notice explains how students enrolled in the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나) in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year can attend public thesis defense presentations.

Please check the date, time and venue of the defense you will attend, and its online participation link, in the attachment to the Master's and Doctoral Public Thesis Defense Schedule notice. The schedule may change at any time, so please check the latest attachment on the day of attendance as well. (That schedule attachment is not included in this notice and was not read.)

1. In-person attendance
Attend at the relevant venue. You do not need to apply separately to the department office.
Complete the attached attendance confirmation form. At the venue, have it signed by the supervising professor of the student whose thesis is being examined. Then submit it to the teaching assistant in charge of the seminar.

2. Online attendance
First confirm which public defenses allow online participation. Then apply for attendance by email to the department office no later than one week before the defense date. The email address is given in the original notice.
In your application email, state your name and student ID number. Also state the name of the student being examined, their program (Master's or Doctoral), and the date and time of the defense. If you are unable to attend after applying, please notify the office by email by the day before the defense.
To join, use the participation link shown in the public schedule attachment. If the link is shown as still being confirmed, please check the latest schedule.
Set your display name in the online meeting to your student ID number and name. Turn on your camera so that your attendance can be confirmed.

3. Submitting the attendance confirmation form for online attendance
After attending the defense, complete the attached attendance confirmation form and submit it to the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
The department office will confirm your attendance by checking your form against the list of attendees submitted by the examining side.

Attachment: Seminar Attendance Confirmation form (세미나 참석 확인서 양식), 1 copy.

Inquiries: Department office, School of Electrical and Information Engineering (전기·정보공학부 학부행정실). Contact details are given in the original notice.

Attached file (1): [Attachment 1] 세미나 참석 확인서 양식.pdf (Seminar Attendance Confirmation form, 124 KB). The content of this file was not read.
